name: coffee-sip
caption: Il porte le café à sa bouche
subject: Upper body of a person in black line, tiny calm head, one hand holding an off-white takeaway coffee cup with a lid, space around.
states: the cup low in the hand | the cup halfway up | the cup at the lips

name: door-open
caption: La porte s'ouvre
subject: A tall off-white door on the left; a whole person in black line stands on its right, always on the right, one hand on it.
states: the door closed | the door half open | the door wide open, light shape inside

name: fever
caption: La fièvre monte
subject: A tiny calm head and a giant black-line hand holding a phone to the ear; a tall off-white thermometer shape beside.
states: the thermometer low | the thermometer half | the thermometer full, three short heat lines

name: chart-rises
caption: Les barres montent
subject: Only a giant black-line hand of finger loops, index pointing up, beside three off-white bars. No head, no person.
states: three short bars | the bars medium | the bars tall, the last one tallest

name: page-turn
caption: Il tourne la page
subject: A big open off-white book held by two giant hands, a tiny head as a profile line above.
states: the book open flat | one page lifted halfway | the page turned over to the left

name: gift-give
caption: Il tend le cadeau
subject: A giant hand holds out a small off-white gift box toward the right; a tiny calm head on the left, the same in every panel.
states: the hand close to the face | the hand halfway out | the arm fully stretched out

name: laces-tie
caption: Le lacet se noue
subject: Only one off-white sneaker shape, its laces as black lines. No hand, head or person.
states: the laces loose | the laces crossed | a big loop bow tied

name: thinker
caption: Il réfléchit
subject: A whole person in black line sitting on an off-white block, tiny head, small plain hands.
states: the hand on the knee | the hand rising | the hand under the chin, a small off-white question mark shape above

name: binoculars
caption: Il regarde au loin
subject: A huge single eye in black line stands for the head, two giant black-line hands holding off-white binoculars.
states: the binoculars low | the binoculars halfway up | the binoculars at the eye

name: run
caption: Il court
subject: A whole person drawn as a black outline only, terracotta inside the body, running right, tiny head, small hands, plain feet. Nothing else.
states: one leg forward | the legs crossing | the other leg forward

name: camera-flash
caption: Le flash part
subject: A giant hand holds an off-white camera shape, a tiny calm head behind it.
states: the camera ready | the finger pressing | a big off-white flash star shape in front

name: sofa-typing
caption: Il tape sur son ordinateur
subject: A person as one line on a sofa line, an off-white laptop shape on the knees, giant hands.
states: hands resting | hands lifted | fingers typing, three short lines above the keys

name: accordion
caption: Il joue de l'accordéon
subject: Two giant hands holding an off-white accordion shape, a tiny head as a profile line above.
states: the accordion closed | the accordion half open | the accordion wide open, two music notes

name: yoga
caption: Il fait du yoga
subject: A person as one line on an off-white mat shape, tiny head, long arms.
states: hands joined at the chest | arms open wide | arms up, one foot on the other knee

name: suitcase-run
caption: Il court avec sa valise
subject: A person as one line running right, pulling an off-white rolling suitcase shape.
states: one leg forward | the legs crossing | the other leg forward

name: envelope-open
caption: L'enveloppe s'ouvre
subject: Centered, small, lots of space: two giant black-line hands open an off-white envelope. No head, face or person.
states: the envelope closed | the flap half open | the flap open, a letter shape rising out

name: checklist-tick
caption: La liste se coche
subject: Only a giant black-line hand with a pen ticking an off-white sheet of three rows. No head, face or person.
states: no ticks | one tick | three ticks

name: snow-globe
caption: La neige tombe
subject: Centered: a snow globe that is a filled off-white shape in every panel, a mountain line inside. No hand, head or person.
states: no snow | a few off-white flakes high | many flakes low around the mountain

name: card-pay
caption: Il paie par carte
subject: Centered, lots of space: a giant black-line hand ending at the wrist holds an off-white card above an off-white terminal with key dots. No head.
states: the card high above | the card halfway down | the card on the terminal, three spark lines

name: cake-eat
caption: Il mange un gâteau
subject: A person in black line, tiny calm head, holds a fork; a slice of off-white cake on a plate in front.
states: the fork in the cake | the fork halfway up | the fork at the mouth, eyes closed happy
